# Bubbles: three columns rising out of the sand (the first one through the clam), two identical
# 5 m fields stacked, rising one field per 6 s: the lower field starts under the sand (hidden

# Columns at (0, 0), (2.6, 1.4), (-2.4, -0.6) in the scene's top view. Generated by make_env.py.
